properties.label_en: Nasser Post (Nasir): inside Nuer territory on the Sobat (c.1900)
properties.label_ar: الناصر: داخل ديار النوير على السوباط (نحو 1900) [Arabic text pending native-speaker review.]
properties.label_detail_en: Interior point, not a limit. Gleichen p.132 gives the Nuer reach along the Sobat and Baro as 'from about east 32° 33' to about 34° 10''; those meridians are recorded in text only (no river geometry on the box to place them).

properties.label_en: Pibor–Akobo junction (Akobo): southern end of the Nuer reach on the Pibor (1901)
